Promote the studio's upcoming free music festival: when, where, and who's playing.

## DATABASE
None. /content/festival.ts exports one Festival with nested lineup. admission = "free". Placeholder name, dates and venue marked TODO.

## UI
Components required:
- FestivalHero — name, tagline, dates, "Free entry" badge, hero image
- Countdown — days until start (client component; hidden once started)

- LineupSchedule — lineup grouped by day, then stage, sorted by time; studio musicians link to their profile
- FestivalFaq — short static Q&A (Is it free? Do I need to register? Parking? Age limit?)

Pages affected:
- /app/festival/page.tsx
